items.text: [trade-tariffs] Tariff measures on imported industrial and consumer inputs raise cost pressure for manufacturers and import-reliant retailers. Exposure: CAT, AMZN, PG, KO. Source: https://www.reuters.com/markets/ (2026-01-14).

[export-controls] Export controls on advanced semiconductors restrict sales of high-end chips to some overseas markets, a direct demand risk for chipmakers. Exposure: NVDA, MSFT. Source: https://www.bis.gov/ (2026-01-21).
[oil-supply] Supply tightness in a major oil-producing region supports crude prices, a tailwind for integrated oil producers. Exposure: XOM. Source: https://www.eia.gov/petroleum/ (2026-01-19).
[energy-policy] Federal renewable-energy incentives extended, supporting utility-scale wind and solar build-out economics. Exposure: NEE. Source: https://www.energy.gov/ (2026-01-09).
[health-pricing] Drug-pricing negotiation framework under review, a margin risk for large pharmaceutical manufacturers. Exposure: JNJ. Source: https://www.cms.gov/ (2026-01-16).

[interest-rates] Central-bank communications signal a cautious, data-dependent path on rates, keeping financing costs a market-wide factor. Exposure: market-wide. Source: https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases.htm (2026-01-28).
